EN: Reserved for Brotherhood of Steel geniuses. Guess that's you.
ZH: 为钢铁兄弟会的天才保留的。我猜就是你吧。

EN: Strike a sinister silhouette in this rugged, but well-worn trail coat.
ZH: 穿上这件坚固而破旧的旅行外套，展现出阴险的轮廓。

EN: Make lists and check them twice. Santa: the original Overseer.
ZH: 制作好心愿表，然后检查两次。圣诞老人——最早的“监督者”。

EN: A super-charged yao-guai could 'bearly' scratch the surface…
ZH: 就算是超级强化妖怪都很难刮伤它的表面……

EN: Wear this, and when you talk, someone may actually listen.
ZH: 穿上这个，这样当你讲话的时候，真的有人会听。

EN: When you give an order, people jump. High.
ZH: 你一下令，人们就会跳起来。跳得老高。

EN: For those times you absolutely need a commanding presence.
ZH: 适合那些你必须拿出威严气场的场合。

EN: You may not live long or prosper, but you'll at least die dreaming.
ZH: 你可能不会活得多福多寿，但至少你能在梦想中死去。

EN: Worn by the Brotherhood of Steel's best and brightest.
ZH: 被钢铁兄弟会里最棒最闪耀的人穿过。

EN: Robes of honor, worn only by Brotherhood of Steel Elders.
ZH: 荣耀的长袍，被钢铁兄弟会长老们穿过。

EN: Typically worn by Brotherhood of Steel scribes.
ZH: 钢铁兄弟会学士们的典型服装。

EN: For when you want all eyes in the room to be on you.
ZH: 当你想成为全场的焦点时，请穿上它。

EN: Show your support for slasher films by dressing like a lunatic!
ZH: 想支持杀人狂电影？请穿得像个疯子一样！

EN: Wearing this makes you look, and even feel, somehow less trustworthy...
ZH: 穿上它后，你似乎更加不值得信赖了……

EN: A suit so slick it helped sell the future.
ZH: 这套西装光鲜至极，当年就是靠它把未来推销了出去。

EN: The perfect mix of style, sophistication and... soda?
ZH: 风格、格调，再掺上点……苏打？完美的混搭。

EN: Good enough for America's troops, good enough for you.
ZH: 配得上美国军队，也配得上你。

EN: Give the tricks, get the treats, and try not to go into sugar shock.
ZH: 不给糖就捣蛋，收了糖果就享用，只是别吃到血糖飙升。

EN: Skeleton – The most popular Halloween costume of 2077 - an American circa 2078
ZH: 骷髅——2077年最流行的万圣节服装，也是2078年前后美国人的标准形象。

EN: Show your thanks for surviving the nuclear Armageddon. And turkey. Delicious, irradiated turkey...
ZH: 你应该对能在核末日中存活下来而心存感激。对火鸡也是。那是美味的，被辐射过的火鸡……

EN: Tis the season to prove Santa still visits your Vault - even if it doesn't have a chimney.
ZH: 又到了证明圣诞老人还会来你的避难所的季节了——即使这里没有烟囱。

EN: Overworked? Underappreciated? Funny uniform? Vault Dweller or Christmas Elf – the choice is yours.
ZH: 过度工作？不被赏识？服装搞笑？避难所居民还是圣诞精灵——你来选择。

EN: Offers great protection from tackles... or Deathclaw hugs.
ZH: 能给你提供很好的保护。躲过他人的阻截……或是死爪的拥抱。

EN: Great for patching up a wounded friend. Or yourself, for that matter.
ZH: 给受伤的朋友包扎伤口正合适，给自己包扎也一样。

EN: Handle anything the Wasteland throws at you. Again and again.
ZH: 能处理任何废土扔给你的东西。一次又一次。

EN: Country chic or fringe hip? Let them wonder.
ZH: 是想走乡村时尚风，还是边缘潮人范儿？让他们猜去吧。

EN: Can't decide between a sweater and a vest? Why not both?
ZH: 不知道穿毛衣还是马甲？为什么不两个一起呢？

EN: An itsy bitsy teeny weeny ye... Never mind.
ZH: 一件很小很小的小小的……衣服。唉算了。

EN: Burn up the dance floor like a true jiving jitterbug.
ZH: 像真正的吉特巴舞者一样燃爆舞池。
学院合成人的基本装备。

EN: Worn by Synths trained for heavy combat.
ZH: 被训练用来进行重型战斗的合成人穿过。
学院认可的废土用装甲。

EN: Fight the good fight... or die tryin'.
ZH: 好好战斗……或者坚持到死亡那一刻。

EN: Ideal for backbreaking farm work and country music performances.
ZH: 适合繁重的农场劳作或是乡村音乐的表演。

EN: A standard Vault Suit modified for the rigors of the Wastes.
ZH: 一件标准的避难所服装，用来适应废土的严酷环境。

EN: Usually reserved for Vault Overseers and their families.
ZH: 通常是给监督者和他们的家人们准备的。

EN: The height of Vault-Tec fashion, reinforced for the Wastes.
ZH: 避难所科技时尚的标杆，为适合在废土生存而强化过。

EN: The coat looks worn, like it's seen too much and plans on seeing more.
ZH: 这件风衣看起来很旧，仿佛见证过太多，还打算继续见证下去。

EN: The style of the future, as seen on TV!
ZH: 电视上看到的未来风格！

EN: Sometimes it takes more than a memo to enforce vault security.
ZH: 有时候，除了备忘录，还需要更多手段来加强避难所的安全性。

EN: Break some hearts with the smartest look in the Vault.
ZH: 用避难所里最潇洒的穿着让心碎成一片。

EN: Comes with a side of lip, a sprinkling of sass, and a bottomless cup.
ZH: 附赠几分俏皮、几分泼辣，还有一只永远续杯的杯子。

EN: The armor of legend, worn by the Wasteland's greatest hero...
ZH: 装甲界的传奇，被废土上最伟大的英雄们穿过……

EN: Hunter or hunted, hero or villain - if you're a badass, suit up.
ZH: 猎手还是猎物，英雄还是恶棍——只要你是狠角色，就穿上它。

EN: The Wasteland classic, fortified for the rigors of heroism.
ZH: 废土经典款，为英雄主义而强化。

EN: Perfect for shrapnel removal or bandaging boo-boos.
ZH: 对于清除弹片和包扎轻伤再合适不过了。

EN: Has plenty of pockets for bandages and painkillers.
ZH: 有很多口袋可以用来装胶布和止痛药。

EN: Amputation, appendectomy, gastric bypass - do it all, in the field!
ZH: 截肢术，阑尾切除术，胃旁路术——在战地上，什么手术都能做！

EN: A classic look for that walk down the aisle.
ZH: 走在红地毯上的经典造型。

EN: Clean and well made. Will definitely draw attention in the Wasteland.
ZH: 干净、做工精良。绝对会在废土上引人注目。

EN: Even Vault children need to learn reading, writing and arithmetic.
ZH: 即使是避难所的小孩也要学习阅读，写作和算术。

EN: Protection and style, in and out of the squared circle.
ZH: 无论擂台内外，防护与造型一样不缺。

EN: The Atom Cats' uniform. Gotta look cool while tinkering with hundreds of pounds of power armor.
ZH: 原子猫帮的制服，毕竟在摆弄数百磅的动力装甲时也得保持酷劲。
避难所时尚的终极宣言。
忏悔者克伦威尔的旧衣
莫伊拉的罗伯科连身衣
新加州共和国游骑兵制服
圣骑士丹斯的动力装甲
圣骑士丹斯的动力装甲
x-01 MK I 动力装甲
